name: spyce-forge
description: The SPYCE PROJECT's consolidated agentic engineering stack — one install that bundles the operating methodology, dual grounding (Context7 for external libs + Graphify for your own codebase), three live MCP servers (Context7, Playwright, and the official Porkbun domain/DNS server), the Ralph autonomy loop, a two-stage reviewer, and a safe domain-acquisition capability — and wires up the external orchestrator (superpowers + Ruflo) via a single PowerShell-first installer with the Playwright collision and hook conflicts handled.
